event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit
event.distribution_pattern: Western Oregon and 1 consignee in Washington

products.product_description: the BREAD STOP Country White Bread 24 oz. The bread is packaged in a plastic bag and twist tie, with the label inside the bag.
products.code_info: This is a small white sticker placed on the outside of the bag containing the bread and represents an expiration date. All product produced prior to April 4, 2014 and date codes 4-10 are being recalled.
products.reason_for_recall: An anti-stick spray containing soy lecithin was used during the manufacture of several varieties of bread and soy was not declared as an ingredient on the product labeling.
